scope: Research-only source reconstruction for exactly eight early Fed episodes; root freezes model forecasts/scorer.
coding_warning: Proposed feature codes are semantic inputs, not M0/M1/M2 forecasts/probabilities. HOLD is never naively inverted to a cut. Goal statements are not forecasts. Current rate action and future guidance must share horizon before divergence is scored.
pit_warning: Certification proposal covers policy-source clocks/content, not original immutable web bytes, execution receipts, pre-event pricing, or market outcome data. All official sources were opened; no search snippet alone used.
